figures.alt: Room with contained ceiling water stain, drywall inspection opening, floor protection, and moisture meter
figures.caption: A clear damage record should show the affected area, visible condition, inspection opening, moisture evidence, and surrounding surfaces before repairs begin.

figures.before: Getting an Independent Contractor Estimate Before the Adjuster Arrives
figures.alt: Florida asphalt-shingle roof with ridge vent, penetration boot, drip edge, and orderly inspection setup
figures.caption: An independent roof inspection can document penetrations, edges, vents, and other conditions that help define the repair scope before the adjuster visit.
